pages.title: Circuit Board
pages.text: The TFMG board, the brain that steers. The core needs two.

pages.title: The chain
pages.text:
- Refine crude oil into plastic
- Plastic Sheets and green dye make an Empty Board
- Deploy a gold plate on it
- Etch it with Sulfuric Acid in a Chemical Vat

- Finish with sequenced assembly: Capacitors, Resistors and a Transistor

Each step is in JEI. It needs a working refinery and a chemical plant, so build these before you plan a trip. See [#](2E5AAC)[Oil](entry://industry/tfmg_oil)[#]().
